figures.label: Hall holds

figures.label: Why the gap

cards.title: Cooling
cards.lead: Trade-offs, not a verdict. Each side is compared with the other held at the current pick; the pick drives every later card. Here the tool’s default pick stays.

figures.label: Picked outside
figures.value: Air-cooled chillers (the dry option: with an air-cooled hall the tool places air-cooled chillers, not dry coolers)

more.title: How each figure is found
more.text: Each option is set, the model rebuilt, the figure read, and the answers put back exactly (the tool’s own functions, nothing stored). Heat captured: R.capture 0.57–0.75 of the heat for liquid to the chip; immersion takes all of it (not verified). Plant space: cooling units with their clear zones (low: units for the low PUE in the most compact block, zones shared between neighbours; high: units for the high PUE in one row; plant.js zoneArea), plus UPS and batteries (and heat pump, liquid loop) at their equipment-only m² per MW. The 1.5 m working space in front of the UPS (CEC 2-310) is not added: no UPS unit sizes are held (?). Water: the make-up water of the Water panel. Noise: the Lw of the units the plant layout places. A type that breaks a set-up check at this size shows “doesn’t fit here”.

missing: electricity per cooling type (the tool uses one PUE range)
sources: Chillers in design winter: Vertiv Liebert AFC installer guide SL-70790, s. 1.4.3 and Table 1.1, p. 10 (register vertivAFC_limits, maker claim): ambient −28.9 to 45 °C, varies by model; not below −20 °C with R1234ze. Design temperature: BCBC App. C Table C-2, Vancouver City Hall, January 2.5 % (register arch_bcbcAppC); tool/data/plant_units.json. A flag, not a block.
Heat captured: R.capture (register liquid_capture, peer figures); immersion = all heat to the liquid (register, not verified).

Plant space: cooling units, wall clearances and spacing from tool/data/plant_units.json (EVAPCO layout manual EAEQPTLYT26 Table 1, V-coil 30–40 ft row: 0.9 m end and 2.1 m side to a wall, 1.8 m end to end, 4.3 m side to side; tower walls BAC J74 2.7 m; tower spacing set in plant.js, no register id ?), maker claims; indoor rooms from register component_space, equipment only.
Water: engine.js waterView (evaporation ≤ 1.5 L per kWh of heat, 2–6 cycles; hybrids wet in the hours above 18 °C; CWEC).
Plant noise: Lw per unit (tool/data/noise.json lwUnit, lwUnitDry; maker claims) plus 10 log N, N from plant.js sizeFor; mitigation from engine.js noiseCheck.
Fit check: site.js setupProblems and the noise check at this size.
